title: Choose the visual world for the Vorcove redesign
question: The roll assigned The Revenue Ledger. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll. Logo and colors stay fixed in every option.

options.label: The Revenue Ledger
options.lineage: the accountant's columnar pad and the P&L every owner reads
options.thesis: The homepage is the ledger from a business review: every leak a line item, ranked by revenue, totaled in beacon orange.
options.viewport: Ruled sheet split on a heavy ink rule: headline and the review button left, a sample review ledger right whose ticked fixes total the recoverable revenue.
options.risk: Sample dollar figures must stay clearly illustrative, or the ledger reads as a results claim.

raised.raise: Palette law: beacon orange is reserved for money found or recovered, never decoration.
States print themselves: sending the review form posts a dated entry to the ledger, not a toast.
Gravity order: every list is ranked by revenue impact, largest first, like the review's fix list.
Computed joint state: ticking fixes in the sample ledger recomputes the recovered total live.
One anchor per section: a total, a demo or the form leads each account; everything else is smaller.
Hard time budget: process steps carry right-aligned durations that sum to the first working version.

options.label: Thermal Leak Survey
options.thesis: Your workflow seen through a thermal camera: cold sea-ink where things work, beacon orange where revenue escapes.
options.viewport: Headline left; right, a flow of enquiry, quote, order, invoice glowing orange at the leaks, with a cold-to-leak legend.
options.risk: Familiar: near-black with a glowing accent is where many AI sites land, and close to the current site.

options.label: Arcade Cabinet
options.thesis: Revenue recovery as a score screen.
options.viewport: Score-style revenue counter over a tile grid.
options.case: Fuses poorly: owners judging a vendor don't identify with arcade play.
options.kept: Palette law: one color reserved by rule for one meaning.

options.label: Phosphor Terminal
options.thesis: The business review as a typed transcript.
options.viewport: A transcript printing the review line by line.
options.risk: Reads as developer tooling and AI-hacker costume.
options.case: Fuses poorly: alienates non-technical owners, blurs the offer.
options.kept: System states print themselves instead of appearing as chrome.

options.label: Glaze Shelf
options.thesis: Leaks as glaze runs ranked on a shelf.
options.viewport: A shelf of samples, each running toward a pool.
options.risk: Craft metaphor with no tie to revenue.
options.case: Fuses poorly: neither the audience nor the offer lives here.
options.kept: Samples ranked in one row, gravity setting reading order.

options.label: Silk Canopy
options.viewport: Translucent service lanes crossing a bright field.
options.risk: Needs a multi-hue palette the pinned colors forbid.
options.case: Fuses poorly: abstract, and breaks the fixed coloring.
options.kept: Overlap as a computed state, not decoration.

options.label: Push Pin Poster
options.thesis: Each section as an illustrated poster.
options.viewport: One silhouette anchoring a poster per section.
options.risk: Candy palette conflicts with the fixed coloring.
options.case: Fuses poorly: decorative, breaks the pinned palette.
options.kept: One emblematic anchor per section, the rest orbiting it.

options.label: Mixtape J-Card
options.thesis: Side A what you run, side B what we build.
options.viewport: A folded inlay with two tracklists.
options.risk: Nostalgic charm undercuts a revenue pitch.
options.case: Fuses poorly: memorable but off-message for buyers.
options.kept: Running times right-aligned; the sides must not overflow the tape.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A polished agency homepage: dark hero, big headline, two buttons, service cards.
canonCard.viewport: Headline and two buttons over sea-ink, four service cards along the bottom.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
